title: Room for Error
supportedClaims: Margin is not wasted space in a financial plan. It is the price of surviving uncertainty and your own imperfect judgment.
When assumptions are tight, ordinary volatility or a small mistake can force terrible decisions at the worst possible time.
The practical move is to build slack into leverage, budgets, timelines, and return expectations before pressure makes flexibility impossible.
caution: Margin can feel inefficient during calm periods, which is exactly why people underinvest in it right before they need it most.
